_comments._source: Income/sink numbers from docs/02-game-design.md; every figure that is a doc default is cited; figures marked 'invented' are tunable placeholders consistent with the §6.2 sanity curve.
_comments.income: docs/02 §6.2 (mid-game target 1,500 cash + 60 flux / real hour), §2.3 (rep: brawls +10-40, story +50-200, bond milestones +25), §3.3 (faction jobs 100-400 cash; businesses 150/in-game day, capped 2 days, designated first cut per §10; materials 1-3/enemy, environmental +20%; scrap sells 5 cash), §2.4 (leader kills 3-8 flux; flux parity rule).
_comments.sinks: docs/02 §2.1 (node curve — see tuning.progression.tree.costCurve; node range 100-1,139 cash / 7-80 flux), §3.2 (room build/upgrade table; workshop Lv3 transmute 10:1 lossy; Private Quarters Lv3 is story — null), §5.3 (dates 50-200 cash, 3-5 real min), §6.2 (gear mods ~300).
_comments.rules: docs/02 §6.2 — price modifiers do NOT stack, single worst applicable modifier wins (hard rule for this file); next meaningful purchase <=45 min away; every sink has a combat path AND a farm/social path; §2.4: no premium currency, no energy system, ever.
_comments.crops: docs/02 §4.2 — flux crops (greenhouse only): 3 tiers, grow 2/4/7 in-game days, yield 8/20/45 flux, tier 2-3 seeds rep/story gated; produce (both sites): tomatoes/sweet corn/hot peppers/herbs, 1-3 day cycles. Seed costs and produce sell prices are invented tunables sized so one flux plot-cycle ~= one good brawl's flux take (§2.4 parity).
_comments.items: docs/02 §4.2 (dishes: consumable combat/social buffs; home-grown hotdish worth 3x a store gift in bond XP), §3.2/§3.3 (workshop bot-tech lane: shield-piercer mods, spoof beacons — scrap-fed), §1.9 (spoof beacon walks a patrol into the lake, quirk 2). Prices invented tunables.

income.fluxParityRule: one flux plot-cycle ~= one good brawl's flux take; with the hard 4-plot cap both lanes land on ~60 flux/real-hour mid-game (docs/02 §2.4)

items.name: Store-Bought Flowers
items.description: A fine gift. A home-cooked hotdish is worth three of these, and the NPC will say so.

items.name: Home-Grown Hotdish
items.description: Cooked from your own corn. Worth 3x a store gift in bond XP (docs/02 §4.2); also fills the hunger-need food slot.

items.name: Pepper Plate
items.description: Consumable combat buff: +10% damage for one fight (docs/02 §4.2).

items.name: Charm Plate
items.description: Consumable social buff: +charm on a date (docs/02 §4.2).

items.name: Shield-Piercer Mod
items.description: Workshop bot-tech lane (docs/02 §3.2): attacks pierce Bulwark frontal shields.

items.name: Spoof Beacon
items.description: Workshop craft (docs/02 §1.9 quirk 2 / §3.3): feeds CIVIS a false directive target — a crafted spoof beacon can walk an entire patrol into the lake.

items.name: Scavenged Materials
items.description: Brawl drops and daily scavenging nodes (docs/02 §3.3). Spent on rooms and workshop crafts.
